Telegram bot starter: aiogram 3, Django 5, Celery; minimal `/start`, user tracking. Extend via `bot.aiogram.handlers`, `bot/models.py`, `bot/admin.py`, `bot/tasks.py`, `.env.example`, `config/settings.py`; include routers in `main.py:42`. Uses `uv` for dependency management - all commands should be run with `uv run python`. Celery worker runs independently - ensure Redis is running for background tasks.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell
